name: Triumph Daytona 675
engine: 675 cc liquid-cooled inline triple, fuel injected
intro: Triumph's triple-cylinder sport bike. The 2006-2009 regulator/rectifier recall is the one to check first.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2006-2009 bikes are in recall 12V445 (regulator/rectifier). Some 2011-2012 bikes are in recall 13V032 (wheel bearings). 2012-2013 bikes are in recalls 13V104 (turn signal stems), 13V215 (throttle cables, 2012) and 13V319 (ABS). Some 2014-2015 675Rs are in recall 15V255 (rear shock).

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier can overheat and stop charging.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a Shindengen regulator/rectifier free.

recalls.what: Wheel bearings of unknown quality may fail early.
Throttle cables may be routed so they hinder the throttle.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a throttle cable guide free.

recalls.what: ABS may malfunction and let the wheels lock.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the ABS modulator free.

recalls.what: Rear shock damping rod nut may loosen.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear shock free.
